featured_reviews.name: Chetan Dhowan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Please BEWARE, when you buy any item made by KENT, as they do not have enough service centers, thus the cost of either delivering your item (if it gets spoilt) is probably 50% of the price of the same item if purchased again.
I faced this with my Auto Soap Dispenser (purchased from Amazon) and again with my Kent Water Kettle also purchased from Amazon.
So firstly the items don't last more than 6 months before getting spoilt and then (if and when) they get spoilt, the service centers call up and say, we can pick up the item and deliver it back to you for a charge of ₹ 300/-.

Which is TRULY PATHETIC !!

Better to buy a better quality product with more service centers.
